name: Permission-aware batch validation
intent: Accept a batch exactly when every integer is nonnegative, preserving read access and every element. Validate the actual Go slice loop, including empty input and negative values at either end.
non_goals: HTTP decoding, external libraries and arbitrary callers are covered by their own empirical checks, not this proof.
The explicit length precondition bounds slices to the maximum 64-bit Go int; this adapter targets 64-bit Go.

requirements.text: The result is true exactly when every batch element is nonnegative.
requirements.ensures: valid == (forall k int :: 0 <= k && k < len(values) ==> values[k] >= 0)

requirements.text: Actual Go execution handles nil, empty, zero, integer extremes and negative-first/last batches without modifying them.
